title: Changes page says what RISE checks and what it does not
acceptance: The /changes list says only what the page re-checks in every digest it shows, RISE's or a listed team's: that it cites only the included pull requests and that its pictures are safe to show. It claims no number or legibility check.

The same line says nothing checks that any change works; the phrase "RISE checks it before showing it" and the word "verified" appear nowhere in the text RISE itself writes on the /changes pages (pull request titles and model text are not RISE's).
A unit test pins the line and fails when either the checks or the disclaimer is dropped.
docs/plans/RISE-CHANGES.md describes the line and why it changed.

evidence.note: Branch fix/changes-honest-copy, local only, not pushed (Windows, npx vitest run src/app/changes.test.js): before the copy change 1 failed, 55 passed (Received the old "A model writes it; RISE checks it before showing it."); after it 56 passed; with "RISE does not check that any change works." removed on purpose 1 failed, 55 passed; restored 56 passed. e2e/changes.spec.js does not pin this line and was not run.

Review correction, branch fix/changes-honest-copy, local only, not pushed (npx vitest run src/app/changes.test.js): with the test pinning the narrower line (citations and safe pictures only; no number, legible or verif) and the old copy, 1 failed, 55 passed; with the new copy 56 passed; with "Nothing checks that any change works." removed on purpose 1 failed, 55 passed; restored 56 passed.

activity.summary: Opened from the owner's decision D10 of the RISE Changes v2 study: the list's "RISE checks it" reads as the claims being checked, and no check reads code, a diff, a test, a check run or a deploy.
Copy changed on branch fix/changes-honest-copy with a pinning unit test; red, green, red again, green recorded. Not pushed, merged, deployed or accepted.

Review correction: the line now claims only what the page re-checks for every digest (citations, safe pictures); numbers and legibility are not claimed. Red, green, red again, green recorded. Not pushed, merged, deployed or accepted.

summary: The /changes list names the checks the page re-runs on every digest (citations, safe pictures) and says nothing checks that any change works.
